title: Parking Occupancy Sensor
headline: Battery-powered parking bay sensor with dual-sensor detection and a 5-year battery, showing free spaces on a live map, built on Axino
photoAlt: Parking sensor opened, showing the Axino LoRa module and batteries
subtitle: A battery-powered sensor bolted into each parking bay, showing drivers the nearest free space on a live map
need: In busy town centres, drivers circle the streets looking for a free space, adding to congestion and air pollution. Councils and car park operators cannot see which bays are free, so they cannot guide drivers or plan enforcement.
A bay sensor has to survive being driven over, run for years without wiring or battery changes, and never report a space as free when a car is parked on it.
role: SciFlair designed and built the system end to end as its own R&D: sensor hardware, firmware, enclosure, cloud service and the driver app.
built: A sensor that bolts to the surface in the centre of each bay and detects whether a vehicle is parked above it
Dual-sensor verification, so a space is only reported as occupied or free when both sensors agree
Battery power with an average life of more than five years, depending on how often the bay changes
An IP66 housing that takes the weight of a vehicle without damaging the electronics
Our Axino communication module, with a choice of LoRa, SigFox or mesh networking
Battery-level and tamper alerts for maintenance
A cloud service and app showing free bays on a live map, with directions to the nearest one

delivery.title: Concept
delivery.text: Defined the stakeholder needs for drivers and operators, and set the measures of performance: detection accuracy, battery life, load rating and cost per bay.

delivery.title: Architecture
delivery.text: Built on the Axino platform so the same sensor board can use whichever low-power network covers the site.

delivery.title: Design and build
delivery.text: Designed the sensor board, firmware and rugged housing, then built working prototypes.

delivery.title: Verification
delivery.text: Tested detection with dual-sensor verification, battery drain against the five-year target, and network reporting to the live map.
